# ITP Master Authority Ontology (Vendored Asset)

This directory contains the vendored, portable distribution of the
**ITP Master Authority Ontology** for standalone use in proof assistant tools
and LSP extensions with zero external repository dependencies.

## Contents
- `master-authority-index.json`: 100 canonical formal concepts across Lean 4, Coq/Rocq, Isabelle/HOL, HOL Light, Agda, and Metamath.
- `cross-itp-concordance.v1.json`: Cross-prover concept and tactic concordance table (`v1.1.0`, 20 mechanisms across 6 provers).
- `handbook-tables.v1.json`: Compiled Goal-Shape Templates, Intent-to-Tactic Phrasebook, Error-to-Fix tables, and Cross-ITP Dialect Mechanisms.
- `book-indexes/`: Author-curated proof assistant textbook index concordances.
